name: wg-easy
description: wg-easy is a WireGuard VPN manager with a web interface for creating and managing clients, QR codes, expiry and per-client firewall rules. It runs the Node.js server from the upstream source alongside wireguard-tools and iptables on the container.

notes.text: Finish the first-run setup in the web UI (admin account and VPN host). Forward UDP 51820 on your router so clients can connect.
The UI is served over plain HTTP on port 80 and sets INSECURE=true so login cookies work. Use a reverse proxy with HTTPS before exposing it to the internet.
Container is privileged: WireGuard needs NET_ADMIN and iptables. Upstream only documents Docker; this script builds the same Node app from the upstream Dockerfile steps.
